feature: Tree rows: a cut row's rest over the edge on hover and sideways scrolling
notes: One mechanism in ui::expandable (#381) for the Project and Database trees: trees scroll sideways to the widest row; a row whose content does not fit shows its rest over the component's edge on hover or when selected with the focus (10 ms delay, border, clicks pass to the row); highlights start 12 px in and a cut row's reaches the edge. Services, Structure, Find in Files, Variables, Search Everywhere, popups and settings trees still draw their own rows
